findings.title: Include partition for diagnostics.c is deliberately non-authoritative
findings.location: Design section 'Include partition', diagnostics.c includes list
findings.problem: Several includes are hedged ('include only if', 'keep whichever are declared here', 'pulled transitively'), delegating the final list to the compiler. Behaviour-neutral, so non-blocking, but camera/camera.h is left as a 'maybe' when it should be plainly omitted (the module reaches G_Universe.camera via universe.h and UpdateCameraFull stays in the facade).
findings.fix: State plainly that diagnostics.c does NOT include camera/camera.h; keep the already-correct viewport_system.h, ui/lpanel_system.h, ui/rpanel_system.h, universe_system.h, world/*, ui/cfont.h, ui/text_region.h, and <math.h>/<string.h>/<stdio.h>/<stdarg.h> includes.

findings.title: DrawUniverseDebugOverlays name no longer matches its reduced role
findings.location: Group C table and 'public entry points' section 2
findings.problem: After the move the function only populates the snapshot via Diagnostics_UpdateSnapshot() and draws nothing, so the name is now a misnomer.
findings.fix: Do NOT rename — the public signature must stay unchanged so the two callers compile. Keep the name as-is with the one-line delegate comment already specified. Recorded only to prevent an incidental rename.

findings.title: RefreshViewportForBasisEdit call-site line number is approximate
findings.problem: The cited call site 'debug_overlay_system.c:833' is near but not exact and will shift as symbols are deleted during the move. The substantive claim (one call site, inside ApplyDebugHotkeyChanges) is correct.
findings.fix: Phrase it as 'the sole call site, inside ApplyDebugHotkeyChanges' without the hard line number.
